items.name: 潮汐仪
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone inventory icon for the unique anomalous relic '潮汐仪' (Tidal Instrument) in the muted post-flood pixel-art game 潮汐线. A complete exquisite antique BRASS ARMILLARY INSTRUMENT: exactly THREE clearly separated interlocking circular metal rings at different crossing angles, outer ring with restrained bold engraved tick marks, tiny gear and mechanical fittings, lightly corroded bronze-gold edges with a few sea-salt crystals. At the visual centre floats a prominent transparent DEEP OCEAN BLUE WATER SPHERE. Its interior contains a clearly legible miniature ocean with a level horizontal sea surface, a single curved SILVER WHITE wave crest, and a very tiny WHITE LIGHTHOUSE SILHOUETTE standing on the water horizon inside the sphere. The miniature ocean is the focal point and the blue sphere should occupy at least a third of the instrument's overall width. Three delicate brass mechanical feet form a sturdy tripod base. Palette: antique bronze gold, deep sea blue, silver white, a few restrained cool cyan reflections. Mood: precise ancient scientific mechanism and impossible supernatural relic. Readable stylised PIXEL ART designed to retain its silhouette at 64x64: bold ring contours, large clear pixel clusters and restrained details, no hairline clutter or antialiasing. Inventory three-quarter display view, fixed upper-left light; no pure black outline. Centre the COMPLETE OBJECT with all rings and all three feet visible, about 80% of a square canvas with generous transparent margins. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. NO text, letters, numbers, frame, scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, large glow, particles, lens flare, extra objects, or human. This is a single icon, not a diagram or collage. The white lighthouse and curved wave must remain INSIDE the blue water sphere; no external lighthouse scenery.
